newsitem.title: UK: Blacks Leisure up, appoints new broker.
newsitem.headline: Blacks Leisure up, appoints new broker.

text.p: Shares in Blacks Leisure Plc rose on Monday after the sports and outdoor clothing group said it appointed Kleinwort Benson as its broker.
The stock was up 11-1/2p at 385-1/2 by 1323 GMT in volume of 565,203 shares, near its record 363p set December 31.
In a brief statement Blacks gave no reason for appointing Kleinwort as its broker and no-one at the company was immediately available for comment.
Blacks shares surged higher through 1996 after ending 1995 at 50p. Last November the company posted a leap in first-half pre-tax profit to 3.9 million stg from 0.7 million stg a year before.
